items.headline: DocuSign reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results on June 4, and the stock reacted lower after the release; the company also highlighted a new product announcement around bringing agreement intelligence and workflows into ChatGPT and Codex.

Nasdaq’s DOCU news feed shows recent Q1 earnings headlines from 2–4 days ago, indicating the June 4 earnings release remained the dominant material catalyst within the last 48 hours window, though the news itself was published just outside that window.
